adjudication.rationale: The diff removes the prior incremental PATCH update specs, including the explicit “succeeds silently when adding non-existent users” and “succeeds silently when removing non-members” cases, and also drops the prior update test that asserted renaming a normal (non-automatic) group (previously `group.name.should == 'fred'`). The new specs add contexts for `.add_members`/`.remove_member` and an automatic-group rename ignore case in `.update`, but they only cover happy paths plus the 422 automatic-group guard. Meanwhile, the new controller code still appears to rely on silent-skip semantics (`User.find_by_username` may return nil and is skipped in `add_members`; `group.users.delete(user_id)` is a no-op if not a member in `remove_member`) and non-automatic rename behavior (`group.name = params[:name] if params[:name] && !group.automatic`) that are now unpinned by tests. This is a concrete, diff-grounded test coverage gap rather than a verified runtime defect.
